source: Figure 6, Section 5.2 (and Appendix F.6), arXiv:2601.23124v2 -- Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer (WDBC), n=569, p=30
reason: The claim is specifically that Semi-knockoffs is model-agnostic across Random Forest, Neural Network and Gradient Boosting on a REAL dataset. Reproducing it requires (a) the WDBC dataset and (b) those three estimators.

The task restricts the environment to stdlib + numpy/scipy/sympy; scikit-learn (which supplies both load_breast_cancer and all three estimators, and which the official code src/experiments/real_data.py depends on) is not installed and installing it was outside the permitted dependency set.

Substituting a synthetic dataset or a linear model for the real WDBC + RF/NN/GB configuration would violate the hard rule against passing a toy off as a real-data reproduction. Reporting 'inconclusive' is the correct outcome.
what_would_be_needed: pip install scikit-learn, then run official_code/src/experiments/real_data.py (which uses sklearn.datasets.load_breast_cancer and RandomForestClassifier / MLPClassifier / GradientBoostingClassifier) and official_code/results/wdbc_main.py for the figure.
